description: A shell script for managing prebuilt tools in an OpenWRT build environment, including functions to refresh timestamps, extract tar files, and handle command-line arguments for setting directories and installing tools.

methods.name: refresh_timestamps
methods.description: Updates timestamps of files in a directory, excluding symbolic links.

methods.name: refresh_prebuilt_tools
methods.description: Refreshes timestamps of build and staging directories after verifying their existence.

methods.name: install_prebuilt_tools
methods.description: Extracts tools tar and refreshes related directories.
